measures: Demonstrated, executable biological capability per species: what the Fish runtime actually does with its evidence-backed knowledge under deterministic scenarios. Not knowledge completeness (species-v2), not scientific confidence, not production readiness, not field accuracy.
doesNotMeasure: field-validated accuracy (synthetic scenarios prove behaviour, not accuracy)
pointsRule: points = weight x fraction; fraction in [0,1] comes from the evaluator's executed tests; species score = sum of points (exact, 6 dp internally; display 1 dp)

criteria.label: Executable species behavior
criteria.award: 1 if at least one usable (evidence-checked) rule executes in its own scenario and drives a non-UNKNOWN species output (or an IN_WINDOW spawn state); else 0

criteria.label: Breadth of executable behaviour
criteria.award: n/5 where n = core behaviour families (temperature, water level/hydrology, habitat, spawning, day/night) in which at least one rule actually executed. Clarity is not a core family (not universally relevant).

criteria.label: Species-specific (not generic) behavior
criteria.award: 1 if the grid output signature is known and unique in the roster; 0.5 if known but identical to another species; 0 if nothing is known

criteria.label: Appropriate uncertainty
criteria.award: share of 3 checks (non-UNKNOWN outputs explained; assessment contract holds; zero-input output is a LOW seasonal prior) x executable breadth (n/5 core behaviour families). Abstention criterion: 0 unless BIO-1 passes

criteria.label: Characteristic behavior is named
criteria.award: share of executed rules that carry a behavior descriptor

criteria.label: Habitat preference executes
criteria.award: 0.5 x execution (1 if a habitat rule is emitted ACTIVE in its applicable scenario; 0.25 if only a surfaced habitat conflict) + 0.5 x annual coverage (months, of 12, in which the runtime emits an ACTIVE habitat preference under some condition state)

criteria.label: Habitat changes with season or conditions
criteria.award: 1 if an executed habitat preference switches off under a contrasting condition or out of season; else 0

criteria.label: KNOWS_DEPTH_PREFERENCE (executable)
criteria.award: 1 if a depth-class habitat rule executes; 0.5 if only a shallow/deep tendency (movement or deep-habitat rule) executes; 0 = HAS_NO_DEPTH_RULE

criteria.label: CAN_EVALUATE_SUPPLIED_DEPTH
criteria.award: share of 2 checks: a supplied depth inside the preferred class is WITHIN, a different class is OUTSIDE/AVOIDED. 0 without a depth-class rule

criteria.label: Depth abstention
criteria.award: share of checks (no supplied depth -> NOT_SUPPLIED; unrecognised depth refused; no depth rule -> no invented preference) x executable breadth (n/5). Abstention criterion: 0 unless BIO-1 passes

criteria.label: Water temperature response
criteria.award: 0.5 x execution ladder (best temperature-family rule: 1 fired + switches off under a contrasting state + outlook moves its way + explained; 0.75 fired + contrast; 0.5 fired; 0.25 conflict surfaced; else 0) + 0.5 x annual coverage (months, of 12, with a known non-conflicting temperature-family output under some temperature state)

criteria.label: Water level / hydrology response
criteria.award: same as ENV-1 for stage, rise, warm/cold rise and discharge rules (coverage over every registered hydrology state)

criteria.label: Other documented influence (clarity)
criteria.award: same as ENV-1 for clarity rules

criteria.label: Missing, degraded and conflicting inputs
criteria.award: share of applicable checks (missing input stays UNKNOWN; degraded input lowers confidence; conflicting favourable+limiting signals give MIXED when constructible) x min(1, executable environmental families / 2). 0 without an executable environmental rule

criteria.label: Spawn window executes
criteria.award: 0.5 x window executes (in-window month + in-range temperature -> IN_WINDOW; out-of-window month + out-of-range temperature -> OUTSIDE) + 0.5 x spawn-period behaviour (in that IN_WINDOW scenario the species output is not UNKNOWN: Fish says what the fish does while spawning, not only when)

criteria.label: Spawn temperature trigger discriminates
criteria.award: share of: in-window month below range -> MONTH_ONLY; out-of-window month in range -> TEMP_ONLY

criteria.label: Seasonal pattern
criteria.award: (seasons, of 4, in which the species' outlook is known on the standard grid; a spawn-window state alone does not count) / 4, x 1 if the behaviour differs between seasons, x 0.5 if it is the same all year

criteria.label: Spawn uncertainty and regional applicability
criteria.award: share of applicable checks: spawn output carries confidence + transferability; a region-restricted window does not fire out of region; an open spawn discrepancy keeps confidence below HIGH

criteria.label: Documented day/night behavior executes
criteria.award: 0.5 x execution (1 if a day/night rule executes, incl. NO_DIFFERENCE_DOCUMENTED; 0.5 if the species' own evidence conflicts and the conflict is surfaced) + 0.5 x annual coverage (months with a known night/day output; counted only when execution = 1)

criteria.label: Behavior vs catchability evidence
criteria.award: only when DN-1 = 1: BEHAVIORAL 1, MIXED 0.75, CATCHABILITY 0.5, UNCLASSIFIED 0.25

criteria.label: Safe day/night abstention
criteria.award: share of checks (missing daypart asserts nothing; no rule -> UNKNOWN with reason; night evidence not used to infer daytime) x executable breadth (n/5). Abstention criterion: 0 unless BIO-1 passes

criteria.label: Applies knowledge to supplied conditions (full runtime)
criteria.award: share of 6 checks on the fish-biological-assessment-v1 output for the species' best-supported scenario (biological assessment, reasons, uncertainty + claim, applicable conditions, evidence references, boundary/contract); x 0.5 when the only biological output is a spawn-window state; 0 if no biological assessment

abstentionPolicy: BIO-4, HAB-5 and DN-3 reward correct UNKNOWN/abstention, are available only to a species that passes BIO-1, and are scaled by executable breadth (core behaviour families executed / 5). ENV-4 (input safety) is scaled by executable environmental families / 2. Universal UNKNOWN earns nothing; narrow knowledge earns proportionally little abstention credit (a one-family species: at most 0.19 of 0.95).

normalizationPolicy.rule: A criterion may be NOT_APPLICABLE only through a reviewed, versioned entry in biologicalExemptions {speciesId: [criterionId], reason}. Exempt weight is removed from the denominator: score = earned / (10 - exemptWeight) x 10. Missing knowledge is never an exemption.

referenceCasePolicy: Human-reviewed reference cases (APPROVED, named reviewer) can only WITHDRAW credit: a failing approved case sets the criterion it checks to 0. PROPOSED cases are run and reported, never scored.

evaluationStatus.EVALUATION_FAILED: explicitly unscored; makes any aggregate that includes the species INCOMPLETE

aggregationPolicy.method: unweighted arithmetic mean of exact species scores over the COMPLETE frozen roster
aggregationPolicy.complete: every roster species ASSESSED under the same rubric and knowledge version
aggregationPolicy.incomplete: value null; status INCOMPLETE; bounds shown (missing species at 0 and at 10); all available species results kept

provenance.knowledgeOfResultsWhenWritten: criteria were written after inspecting the runtime and rule inventory, before the first full scoring run; category weights are the owner's, unchanged
provenance.approval: APPROVED by the owner 2026-10-19 (rubric 2.1.0 + cohorts v2); publication gated

coveragePolicy: Execution alone shows a behaviour EXISTS; annual coverage shows how much of the year Fish can speak to it. Coverage is measured by running the runtime for 12 months x every registered condition state (not read from rule metadata). A month without an evidence-backed output is genuinely UNKNOWN for that fish, so it earns no coverage credit. Added during development after the first full run showed one rule earning a whole family's credit (TARGET 7.96 before, see FISH_BIOLOGICAL_CAPABILITY_V2.md section 9).

Then a separately reviewed scorer-job/Publisher change; no writer exists today.

frozen.by: owner decision 2026-10-19 (approve rubric 2.1 with cohorts v2 as the initial baseline; freeze weights, criteria and cohort membership)
frozen.rule: Weights, criteria, award rules, policies and roster membership are frozen. The scorer refuses any drift from these fingerprints. A change requires a new rubric or cohorts version and owner approval; it is never applied to raise scores, and results across versions are NOT_COMPARABLE.

speciesResult.location: private research workspace: Sector Research/fish-brain/analysis/capability-v2/demo-2026-10-19-rubric-2.1/approved-2.1.0/result.json (per-species scores, categories, missing capabilities, research backlog; private because the evidence carries rule identifiers)

approvedBaseline.howToMeasureAgainstIt: python3 brains/fish/runtime/capability_run.py --bundle <release> --out <dir> --previous <approved baseline result.json>: the change record is marked againstApprovedBaseline and gives exact per-species, per-category, per-criterion and aggregate deltas.
